faq.question1: است این رایگان plan really رایگان forever?
faq.answer1: Yes! Our Truly Free plan includes 1 human agent for life with unlimited conversations, chat history, and contacts. Plus, you get 1 AI agent with 100 lifetime AI replies to try our AI features. No credit card required, no hidden fees.
faq.question2: What's این difference between ماهانه و سالانه billing?
faq.answer2: با سالانه billing, you save 2 months روی این پریمیوم plan ($299/year vs $359.88/year if پولی ماهانه). این billing cycle only affects این پریمیوم plan - این رایگان plan است همیشه رایگان و سازمانی است سفارشی قیمت‌گذاری.

faq.question4: What happens if I exceed my AI reply limit on the Free plan?
faq.answer4: The Free plan includes 100 lifetime AI replies. Once you reach this limit, you'll need to upgrade to Premium for unlimited AI responses. Your human agent functionality remains unlimited on all plans.
faq.question5: How does این پریمیوم plan قیمت‌گذاری work?

q1.answer: SeaVoice provides real-time voice conversations with advanced AI that can understand context, handle interruptions, and deliver human-like responses over the phone. Unlike text-based chatbots, SeaVoice handles actual voice calls with natural speech patterns.

q3.answer: Our advanced voice technology creates very human-like conversations. While some callers may notice, most find the experience natural and helpful. You can also customize the AI to introduce itself as an AI assistant if preferred.

q6.question: Can I customize the AI's voice?
q6.answer: Yes! You can choose from multiple voice options, adjust tone and speaking style, and even clone custom voices for Enterprise plans. The AI can be trained to match your brand's communication style.

q7.question: است SeaVoice multilingual?
q7.answer: Yes, SeaVoice supports گفتگوها در over 10 languages including English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Russian, Chinese, و Japanese.

q8.question: What industries benefit بیشتر از SeaVoice?
q8.answer: SeaVoice works well across industries including healthcare, real estate, hospitality, financial services, e-commerce, professional services, and any business that handles high call volumes or needs 24/7 availability.

q9.question: می‌تواند SeaVoice مدیریت emergency تماس‌ها?
q9.answer: While SeaVoice می‌تواند مدیریت urgent inquiries و escalate appropriately, we توصیه می‌کنم maintaining direct emergency protocols. SeaVoice می‌تواند باشد configured به فوری transfer emergency-related تماس‌ها به human operators.
